030package dev.visdb.seesaw.utils;
031
032import java.lang.StackWalker.Option;
033import java.lang.StackWalker.StackFrame;
034import java.lang.System.Logger;
035import java.util.Optional;
036import java.util.Set;
037
038/**
039 * Convenience methods for Java.
040 */
041public class JStuff {
042  private JStuff() {}
043
044  /**
045   * Shorthand for "String.format(fmt, args)".
046   * @param fmt format
047   * @param args args
048   * @return string
049   */
050  public static String sf(String fmt, Object... args) {
051    return args.length == 0 ? fmt : String.format(fmt, args);
052  }
053
054  /**
055   * Return the Logger for the caller.
056   *
057   * @return the Logger
058   */
059  public static Logger getLogger() {
060    Class<?> cc = StackWalker.getInstance(Option.RETAIN_CLASS_REFERENCE).getCallerClass();
061    return getLogger(cc.getName());
062  }
063
064  /**
065   * Return the logger name for the caller.
066   * @return logger name
067   */
068  public static String getLoggerName() {
069    Class<?> cc = StackWalker.getInstance(Option.RETAIN_CLASS_REFERENCE).getCallerClass();
070    return cc.getName();
071  }
072
073  /**
074   * Return a logger for the name.
075   * @param loggerName name
076   * @return logger
077   */
078  public static Logger getLogger(String loggerName) {
079    return System.getLogger(loggerName);
080  }
081
082  /**
083   * Get a "class.method" name from the call stack.
084   * The skip param indicates how far down the stack to look for
085   * the caller's frame. For example, if {@code getCaller(skip)} is
086   * used in a message supplier in a log statement need to skip more
087   * than other cases:
088   * {@snippet :
089   *     void someMethod() {
090   *         log(Level, () -> String.format("Called by: {%s}", getCaller(4)))
091   *     }
092   * }
093   * logs the name of the method that called someMethod.
094   *
095   * @param skip
096   * @return "simpleClassName.methodName"
097   */
098  public static String getCaller(int skip) {
099    Optional<StackFrame> caller
100        = StackWalker.getInstance(Set.of(Option.RETAIN_CLASS_REFERENCE), skip + 1)
101              .walk(s -> s.skip(skip).findFirst());
102    // if (Boolean.FALSE) {
103    //  // For a verbose mode.
104    //  StackFrame frame = caller.get();
105    //  Objects.nonNull(frame.getFileName());
106    //  Objects.nonNull(frame.getLineNumber());
107    // }
108    String meth = caller.isEmpty() ? null
109                                   : caller.get().getDeclaringClass().getSimpleName() + '.'
110                                         + caller.get().getMethodName();
111    return meth;
112  }
113}
